notes: Printable boxes preserve source geometry and base plates; bounds include bases.
Wood assembly y is reflected from original rear-left-bottom coordinates so fronts share min-y convention.
Windows are thin facade accents placed outside source faces for rendering; not printable hole geometry. Wood windows are engraving outlines, not cut-out windows.
Use wood panels for physical 2 mm assembly, or boxes for a lighter preview. Never render both overlapping sets.
Three.js Y-up mapping: BoxGeometry(w,h,d), position(x+w/2-W/2,z+h/2,y+d/2-D/2). Rotate entire group around world Y for plan orientation.
